subject: seal
name: 小海豹
label: 趴着的小海豹
learning: 先看大的轮廓，再挑一两处喜欢的地方画。
prompt: Use case: original standalone picture-book illustration for Nilo children's drawing references. Make ONE square monochrome raster artwork, beautifully hand-drawn with confident dark charcoal-black contours, graceful proportions and clean open white spaces. Pure white background, preserve ample clear margin all around, complete subject fully visible. No color fills, gray washes, shading, dense hatching, fine texture, logos, letters, numbers, border, collage, grid, watermark or instructional steps. Do not imitate a named artist. BEGINNER reference: a warm simple picture-book drawing, 3–5 large easy-to-read forms and a small number of necessary interior marks. Broad rounded organic silhouettes; no repetitive decoration. One plump seal pup front three-quarter view, round head, two broad front flippers and a small forked rear tail. Smooth open contours and empty interiors: absolutely no fur strokes, hair, feather texture, scales or hatching. Keep 10 percent clear space on every side.
